anomalies.description: Two individuals appear to engage in a brief physical confrontation near the curb before one falls to the ground; however, the initial contact is ambiguous and could be part of the subsequent abuse event.
A person in dark clothing repeatedly strikes or kicks a second individual who is lying motionless on the sidewalk, indicating an attack on a helpless victim.
A person in dark clothing is seen kicking or striking a person lying on the sidewalk, who appears motionless and helpless; the attacker then walks away.

A person is lying on the sidewalk in a prone position at 21.5s (f12), then appears to be sitting up or propped on elbows by 22.0s (f13) and remains seated through 23.0s (f15). No clear aggressor is visible in the frames, but the sudden transition from lying to sitting—without visible assistance—and the context of prior movement suggest possible prior assault or collapse due to external force. The person appears disoriented or incapacitated, consistent with being a helpless victim of abuse.
